description:

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy and that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from diverse backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values diverse backgrounds. We believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful. At Target, inclusion is part of the core value. We aim to create equitable experiences for all, regardless of their dimensions of difference. As an equal opportunity employer, Target provides diverse opportunities for everyone to grow and win

**Team Overview**

**Managed Kubernetes** is part of Target Infrastructure Services, providing the foundational container platform for deploying and operating applications across Target data centers and public cloud environments. The platform enables engineering teams to build and operate scalable, reliable services without having to manage the complexity of the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure. Through API- and UI-driven automation, teams can provision, upgrade, and manage Kubernetes clusters at scale across on-premises and cloud environments. The platform also provides curated capabilities for security, observability, compliance, and resiliency. By providing a consistent Kubernetes experience across Target data centers and public cloud, Managed Kubernetes reduces operational complexity, improves reliability, and accelerates application and platform development across Target.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a **Lead Engineer – Kubernetes Platform** with extensive platform engineering experience in designing, building, automating, and operating cloud-native platforms. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Kubernetes, cloud-native technologies, and platform automation, with a strong focus on reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence. This role will provide technical leadership in evolving our Kubernetes platform across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.

**Required Skills**

* Strong software development experience in **Go (Golang)**.
* Extensive hands-on experience **designing, administering, and operating Kubernetes platforms, including cluster provisioning, configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, and production operations.**
* Strong experience running Kubernetes on public cloud platforms. Experience with **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**and **Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)** is preferred; equivalent experience with AWS, Azure, or other public cloud platforms is also acceptable.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture and networking, including **CNI plugins, ingress controllers, services, network policies, load balancing, traffic routing, and service connectivity.**
* Experience with **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** and Kubernetes deployment tools such as **Terraform**, **Helm**, and **Kustomize**.
* Experience implementing **GitOps** practices using tools such as **Argo CD** and/or **Flux**.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD automation and modern software delivery practices for Kubernetes platforms.
* Experience with **observability solutions, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, distributed tracing, and platform reliability.**
* Experience administering Linux operating systems and optimizing container host environments.
* Experience with Kubernetes storage technologies, including CSI drivers, Persistent Volumes (PV), Persistent Volume Claims (PVC), Storage Classes, StatefulSets, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Strong automation-first mindset with experience managing infrastructure and platform services as code using version control, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification is a plus.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, automate, and operate Kubernetes platform services across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments.
* Develop platform tooling, controllers, and automation using Go (Golang).
* Design, implement, and manage GitOps and CI/CD workflows to automate application and infrastructure deployments across multi-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Manage, optimize, and scale Kubernetes clusters, including Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and the supporting cloud infrastructure.
* Drive platform observability, reliability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence.
* Lead platform initiatives including Kubernetes upgrades, cluster migrations, networking enhancements, storage architecture, scalability improvements, and platform modernization.
* Define platform architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technical strategy.
* Partner with engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and self-service cloud-native platform capabilities.
* Serve as a technical subject matter expert, mentor engineers, and influence engineering best practices across teams.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define platform roadmaps and balance product requirements with long-term platform sustainability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or a related field.

title: IH Salesforce Production Support - Cigna Healthcare
description:
Technical Support Analyst
  
  
Position Information
  
  

* Job Title: Technical Support Analyst
* Function: Production Support / Salesforce Support
* Employment Type: Full-time
* Location: Bangalore
* Reports To: Cloud Support Manager

Role Purpose
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst is a hands-on member of the Production Support team, responsible for supporting and maintaining Salesforce applications used across Cigna International Health.
  
  
The primary focus of the role is day-to-day Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access and permissions, declarative configuration, data maintenance, reporting, and operational support. The role also investigates and manages application incidents through ServiceNow, working with business users, technical teams, and senior support colleagues to restore service, meet agreed service levels, and provide a high standard of customer support.
  
The successful candidate will work with appropriate autonomy, prioritize their workload, and deliver accurate, controlled, and well-documented outcomes. They will escalate work requiring development, architecture decisions, elevated privileges, or higher-risk production changes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce Administration and User Access
  
  

* Create, update, activate, freeze, and deactivate Salesforce users in accordance with approved access requests and user lifecycle procedures.
* Maintain user access through profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, public groups, and other approved access mechanisms.
* Investigate and resolve common login, visibility, permission, object-access, field-access, and record-access issues.
* Maintain access hygiene by reviewing assignments, identifying inappropriate or obsolete access, and supporting periodic access reviews.
* Apply least-privilege and segregation-of-duties principles, escalating privileged, unusual, or high-risk access requests to the appropriate security, identity-management, or senior Salesforce resource.
* Maintain clear evidence of approvals and completed access changes where required for audit or control purposes.

Declarative Configuration and Platform Maintenance
  
  

* Configure and maintain Salesforce using approved declarative, “clicks-not-code” capabilities.
* Support routine changes to standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, queues, assignment rules, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and other administrative configurations.
* Assist with basic Salesforce Flow configuration and troubleshooting where the requirement is within the role’s approved administrative scope.
* Perform configuration and operational support across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud.
* Validate changes in an appropriate lower environment before production implementation, following established testing, approval, deployment, and post-implementation validation procedures.
* Monitor the impact of routine Salesforce releases and support low-risk readiness or validation activities.
* Escalate requirements involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, complex integrations, architecture changes, or development-intensive solutions.

Data Maintenance and Reporting
  
  

* Maintain Salesforce data accurately and securely, including approved record creation, updates, corrections, ownership changes, and controlled bulk activities.
* Support data imports, exports, and mass updates using authorized tools and documented procedures.
* Complete appropriate validation and reconciliation before and after data changes.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, obsolete, or inconsistent information and work with data owners to improve data quality.
* Create and maintain standard reports and dashboards to support operational and business requirements.
* Protect sensitive information and avoid unapproved data deletion, extraction, or other high-risk data activity.
* Maintain traceable records of approvals, test results, data files, outcomes, and rollback information where required.

Incident and Application Support
  
  

* Monitor and manage incidents and support requests assigned through ServiceNow.
* Review ticket information, confirm the reported symptoms and business impact, and gather any additional information required to investigate the issue.
* Validate that the correct application or configuration item is recorded and ensure the incident is assigned to the appropriate support group.
* Investigate common Salesforce and supported application issues, including user access, permissions, configuration, data, workflow, and functional errors.
* Reproduce issues where appropriate, review available documentation and known issues, and identify a resolution, workaround, or appropriate escalation path.
* Maintain accurate ticket states and remain aware of applicable responses and resolution of SLAs.
* Record meaningful internal investigation details, actions taken, dependencies, and escalation of information in work notes.
* Provide clear and timely customer updates through the appropriate customer-visible ServiceNow fields.
* Reassign incidents promptly when another team is required, documenting the reason for reassignment.
* Complete accurate resolution information and clear resolution notes before resolving a ticket.
* Escalate major, high-impact, recurring, security-related, or technically complex incidents in accordance with established support procedures.

Documentation, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Create and maintain clear operational documentation, runbooks, support procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
* Identify repetitive, manual, or error-prone activities that may be suitable for controlled automation.
* Contribute to the design, testing, documentation, and ongoing monitoring of low-risk automation solutions.
* Recommend improvements that increase support efficiency, data quality, customer experience, control effectiveness, or service reliability.

Collaboration and Customer Service
  
  

* Work effectively with geographically distributed colleagues across business, production support, identity and access management, security, product, engineering, and development teams.
* Translate technical issues into clear, practical information for both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Manage assigned work with appropriate autonomy, balancing priorities, risk, business impact, and SLA commitments.
* Provide accurate, professional, and customer-focused communication throughout requests and incidents.
* Seek guidance when requirements are unclear and escalate promptly when an issue exceeds the role’s authority or technical scope.

Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* Minimum of three years of professional experience working as a Salesforce Administrator.
* Practical administration experience across:
* Sales Cloud
* Service Cloud
* Experience Cloud
* Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce user provisioning, deactivation, access management, profiles, roles, permission sets, permission set groups, licenses, queues, and public groups.
* Experience configuring standard and custom objects, fields, page layouts, record types, list views, validation rules, assignment rules, reports, and dashboards.
* Experience with declarative Salesforce administration and basic Flow configuration or troubleshooting.
* Experience performing controlled data imports, exports, corrections, bulk updates, and data-quality activities.
* Demonstrated experience supporting production applications and investigating user, access, configuration, data, and functional issues.
* Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, ticket records, change evidence, and audit trails.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to security, data protection, operational risk, and change control.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritize assigned work, work independently within defined procedures, and recognize when escalation is required.

Preferred or Desirable Skills
  
  

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including incident handling, work notes, customer updates, resolution information, and SLA awareness.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
* Experience supporting Salesforce in a health insurance, healthcare or other regulated environment.
* Experience with access reviews, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties controls, or identity and access management processes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, Jira, Confluence, knowledge management, release-readiness activities, user acceptance testing, and smoke testing.
* Exposure to application-monitoring or log-analysis tools such as Dynatrace or Splunk.
* Experience identifying opportunities to automate recurring administrative or support activities.

Behaviors and Competencies
  
  

* Customer focused: Provides responsive, accurate, and professional support.
* Team player: Collaborates openly across geographic, business, and technical boundaries.
* Problem solver: Investigates methodically and uses evidence to reach sound conclusions.
* Autonomous: Takes ownership of assigned work while escalating appropriately.
* Process minded: Follows documented controls and maintains complete, traceable records.
* Security and risk aware: Protects access, data, system stability, and audit integrity.
* Curious and adaptable: Learns unfamiliar applications and business processes confidently.
* Continuous-improvement driven: Challenges inefficient manual processes and proposes safe, practical improvements.
* Clear communicator: Explains technical matters effectively to different audiences.
* Dependable: Manages priorities and delivers work to agreed time and quality expectations.

Scope of the Role
  
  
This is primarily a Salesforce administration and production-support position, not a Salesforce developer or solution-architect role. The analyst is expected to complete routine declarative configuration and operational support independently within approved procedures. Custom development, complex integration work, architecture decisions, privileged actions, and high-risk production changes must be referred to the appropriate senior administrator, engineering, architecture, security, or development team.
  
Measures of Success
  
  
**Success in the position will be demonstrated through:**  

* Timely and accurate completion of user lifecycle and access requests.
* Achievement of applicable incident and request SLAs.
* High-quality investigation notes, customer communications, and resolution records.
* Secure, accurate, and controlled Salesforce configuration and data maintenance.
* Complete change, approval, testing, and audit evidence.
* Effective escalation of work outside administrative scope.
* Current, usable operational documentation and knowledge articles.
* Measurable contribution to automation, process improvement, and reduced recurring support efforts.

About The Cigna Group
  
  
Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

At Enverus, we’re committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.  
  
We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we’re helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.  
  
The energy industry is changing fast. But we’ve continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn’t be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.  
  
Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

**About the Role**  
As a Salesforce Billing Administrator, you will support and maintain the day-to-day operations of our Revenue Cloud environment, working closely with Salesforce Billing consultants and the Global Revenue Team. You will investigate and resolve billing cases, manage configurations, and ensure data accuracy across billing processes. This role is ideal for someone with hands-on CPQ and Billing experience who enjoys troubleshooting complex issues, improving system reliability, and partnering with global teams in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

**Performance Objectives**

* Hands-on experience implementing Salesforce Billing, including Contract Renewal, amendments, Subscriptions, Billing Rules, Tax rules, invoice scheduler and Payment.
* Work alongside Salesforce Billing consultants to understand the existing implementation, recurring issues, and system architecture — then take progressive ownership of day-to-day support.
* Investigate and resolve Salesforce Billing cases; identify root causes of recurring issues and apply permanent fixes.
* Manage Revenue Cloud configurations — billing rules, invoice schedules, and product setup.
* Build and maintain custom reports and dashboards for the Global Revenue Team.
* Set up and maintain invoice templates using Conga.
* Perform database maintenance — diagnostic testing, duplicate cleansing, and data quality governance.
* Resolve Sales Tax issues and maintain compliance with billing records.
* Provide end-user training and support for billing processes and new releases.
* Hands-on experience in flows.
* Experience across the SDLC, including Agile methodologies, sandbox-based development, and deployment best practices.
* This role requires flexibility to support night shifts during revenue close periods or when global team coverage is needed.
* Attend team meetings via video call with camera on.

**Competitive Candidate Profile**

* 2–4 years of hands-on Salesforce Administration experience in Billing
* Thorough understanding of Quote to cash process.
* Understanding of Salesforce CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote).
* Hands-on experience with declarative Salesforce tools (Flows, validation rules, reports & dashboards).
* Good communication skills; comfortable working with global teams over video calls.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Salesforce Certified Administrator — required.
* Additional certifications (Platform App Builder, Billing Specialist, CPQ Specialist) are a plus.

description:

**CRM Customer Data Steward**

 **POSITION PURPOSE:**



The CRM Customer Data Steward is a hands\-on business data stewardship role responsible for ensuring that customer data in CRM is trusted, complete, well\-structured, governed, and ready for commercial use, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled customer engagement. The role focuses on improving the quality and usability of CRM customer data across markets, platforms, and customer\-facing processes.



This role owns the day\-to\-day stewardship routines for CRM customer data, including business definitions, metadata, data quality checks, issue triage, remediation follow\-up, glossary management, and process documentation. It ensures that customer records, account hierarchies, contact data, segmentation attributes, consent and preference data, interaction data, and CRM process data are managed consistently and can be reused across reporting, Customer360, field\-force effectiveness, personalization, and AI\-supported use cases.



The role is forward\-looking and automation\-minded. It does not only maintain CRM data; it continuously improves how CRM processes work. This includes identifying manual steps, recurring data quality issues, duplicate work, approval bottlenecks, exception handling gaps, and reporting friction — then translating these into practical improvements, workflow automation opportunities, AI\-enabled support, and scalable stewardship practices.



As CRM becomes more connected with customer engagement, commercial execution, analytics, and AI, this role strengthens the data foundation needed for better decisions and better customer interactions. It helps ensure that CRM data is not only correct, but also understandable, connected, explainable, compliant, and ready to power future capabilities such as Customer360, next\-best\-action, AI\-assisted field\-force planning, automated data quality controls, and conversational analytics.

  


**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own CRM customer data stewardship routines, ensuring customer data in CRM is accurate, complete, consistent, timely, compliant, and fit for business use across markets, customer\-facing teams, and connected systems.
* Improve CRM data quality end\-to\-end by monitoring completeness, duplication, consistency, timeliness, usability, and business relevance across customer accounts, contacts, hierarchies, segmentation attributes, consent indicators, interaction data, and related CRM objects.
* Lead day\-to\-day CRM customer data operations, including data creation, maintenance, enrichment, correction, validation, approval workflows, duplicate resolution, controlled retirement, and issue resolution.
* Define, maintain, and enforce CRM customer data standards, including business definitions, required fields, metadata, glossary terms, validation rules, account hierarchies, customer classifications, ownership rules, and source\-system references.
* Own CRM metadata and glossary management, ensuring key customer data elements, definitions, ownership, quality rules, lineage, and approved business terminology are documented and consistently understood by business and technical teams.
* Establish and manage CRM data quality monitoring, including scorecards, KPIs, service levels, dashboards, issue logs, root\-cause analysis, remediation tracking, and continuous improvement actions.
* Act as the lead escalation point for CRM customer data issues by assessing business impact, prioritizing defects, coordinating resolution, communicating risks, and preventing recurring problems through sustainable process or system fixes.
* Translate CRM business requirements into executable data rules, validation logic, workflow steps, approval processes, exception handling, and issue\-resolution playbooks.
* Identify and drive opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate CRM processes, including manual data entry, data validation, duplicate detection, enrichment workflows, approval routing, exception handling, quality checks, and stewardship reporting.
* Partner with CRM product owners, business teams, Sales, Customer Engagement, Commercial Excellence, eCommerce, analytics, IT, data engineering, privacy, security, and local market teams to align CRM data capabilities with business priorities and priority use cases.
* Support the design and continuous improvement of CRM customer data models, customer hierarchies, segmentation frameworks, Customer360, field\-force reporting, customer engagement insights, and enterprise customer master data capabilities.
* Ensure CRM data is ready for AI\-enabled use cases by improving business context, metadata, semantic definitions, consent awareness, data quality rules, and explainability of customer data used in analytics, automation, and AI tools.
* Support AI\-enabled CRM transformation by helping define the data foundations required for next\-best\-action, AI\-assisted customer planning, conversational analytics, automated recommendations, customer prioritization, and more intelligent field\-force workflows.
* Coordinate onboarding and integration of new CRM customer data sources and datasets, ensuring validation, testing, governance approval, documentation, process alignment, and stakeholder adoption.
* Manage stewardship activities across global and local teams, ensuring consistent use of CRM data definitions, business rules, quality standards, issue\-management processes, and responsible data usage.
* Work with internal and external data providers, CRM implementation partners, technology vendors, system integrators, and managed service teams to ensure reliable, documented, high\-quality, and sustainable CRM data delivery.
* Act as the business\-side quality gate for externally delivered CRM data work, including cleansing, enrichment, matching, migration, automation, dashboarding, and governance deliverables.
* Train and enable local data stewards, CRM administrators, business users, and customer\-facing teams on CRM data standards, stewardship routines, issue handling, data quality expectations, and responsible use of AI\-enabled tools.
* Communicate CRM data updates, quality issues, governance changes, risks, decisions, automation opportunities, and improvement actions clearly to stakeholders and user communities.
* Enable CRM data products, Customer360, analytics, AI initiatives, personalization, reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making by ensuring CRM customer data is trusted, explainable, connected, and ready to use.

  


**WHO YOU ARE:**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Business Administration, Computer Science, Commercial Operations, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in CRM data stewardship, customer data management, CRM operations, master data management, data quality, business analysis, data governance, or commercial data operations.
* Strong understanding of CRM customer data concepts, including account and contact data, customer identifiers, account hierarchies, customer segmentation, consent and preference data, interaction history, territories, field\-force data, deduplication, match\-and\-merge, survivorship, and golden records.
* Practical experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, Veeva, IQVIA OCE, CustomerTimes, BayTouch, Asseco, or comparable CRM solutions; experience with MDM platforms such as SAP MDG, Informatica, Reltio, TIBCO EBX, or comparable tools is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data stewardship and data governance practices, including data ownership, stewardship routines, metadata management, business glossaries, data quality KPIs, issue triage, lineage, access, privacy, consent, and change control.
* Experience improving CRM processes through standardization, automation, workflow redesign, better controls, clearer ownership, and more scalable operating routines.
* Ability to translate business needs and CRM pain points into clear data standards, business rules, process requirements, validation logic, automation opportunities, and operational workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with data analysis, issue investigation, data quality reporting, and root\-cause analysis; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable tools is an advantage.
* AI\-curious and automation\-minded, with a practical understanding of how CRM data structure, metadata, business context, consent, and quality influence analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and AI\-assisted business workflows.
* Good understanding of how CRM customer data supports Customer360, customer engagement, field\-force effectiveness, segmentation, personalization, next\-best\-action, commercial reporting, and AI\-enabled decision support.
* Experience working with external partners, CRM vendors, system integrators, data providers, or managed service teams, with the ability to define requirements, challenge quality, validate outputs, and ensure sustainable handover.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across global, regional, and local teams and explain CRM data issues clearly to non\-technical business users.
